title: To my forever Love
description:
simple 2D platformer with just jumps and hooks!
Features of this game
1. Minimalist Visuals and story
2. Extremely Simplified Controls
3. Abundant gimmicks and a variety of level designs
4. Challenging difficulty and rewarding achievements

Only device used is mouse. Jump with left-click!

Hook with right-click. It delivers you more (cannot use at first)!

If any mistakes, you can restart right away!

Feel free to webcast, video production or monetize (including super chat).
I hope you enjoy it!

amay.
description_short: 2D platformer in which you cannot walk. I wish you a fruitful journey.
